sentences.zh: 廣順元年春二月癸巳朔，以樞密副使、尚書戶部侍郎範質為兵部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangshun, on the new moon of the second month of spring, on the day guisi, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Revenue in the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Vice Minister of War, continuing in his previous office;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangshun, on the new moon of the second month of spring, on guisi day, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Vice Minister of War while retaining his existing duties;

sentences.zh: 以陳州刺史、判三司李穀為戶部侍郎，判三司；

translations.literal: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen prefecture and Commissioner of the Three Offices, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of the Three Offices;
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen and Commissioner of the Three Offices, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and continued as Commissioner of the Three Offices;

sentences.zh: 以右金吾大將軍、充街使翟光鄴為左千牛衛上將軍，充宣徽北院使；

translations.literal: Zhai Guangye, General of the Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was made General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guangye, General of the Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was appointed General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使袁鳷為左武衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使；

translations.literal: Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made General of the Left Martial Guard and Commissioner of the South Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed General of the Left Martial Guard and Commissioner of the South Bureau;

sentences.zh: 以左右金吾大將軍、充街使符彥琳為右監門上將軍。

translations.literal: Fu Yanlin, General of the Left and Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was made General of the Right Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanlin, General of the Left and Right Golden Guard and Street Commissioner, was appointed General of the Right Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以皇子天雄軍牙內都指揮使、檢校右僕射、貴州刺史榮起復為澶州節度使、檢校太保，以右金吾上將軍薛可言為右龍武統軍，以左神武統軍安審約為左羽林統軍，以左驍衛上將軍趙贊為右羽林統軍，以太子太師致仕宋彥筠為左衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army's personal guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui prefecture, was restored to office as Military Commissioner of Bian prefecture and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, was made Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was made General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui, was restored as Military Commissioner of Bian and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, became Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, became Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, became Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; and Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was appointed General of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔移生吐渾族帳於潞州長子縣江豬嶺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relocation of the living Tuyuhun tribal encampments to Jiangzhu Ridge in Changzi county, Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Tuyuhun encampments moved to Jiangzhu Ridge in Changzi county, Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左武衛上將軍劉遂凝為左神武統軍，以左衛上將軍焦繼勛為右神武統軍，以左領軍衛上將軍史佺為右衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Liu Suening, General of the Left Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, was made Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, was made General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Liu Suening, General of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, became Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; and Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, became General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚子，故吳國夫人張氏追贈貴妃；

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the late Lady Zhang, Lady of the State of Wu, was posthumously honored as Noble Consort;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the late Lady Zhang of Wu was posthumously created Noble Consort;

sentences.zh: 故皇第三女追封樂安公主；

translations.literal: the late third imperial daughter was posthumously created Princess of Le'an;
translations.idiomatic: the late third imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Le'an;

sentences.zh: 故第二子青哥贈太保，賜名侗；

translations.literal: the late second son Qingge was posthumously made Grand Guardian and given the name Tong;
translations.idiomatic: the late second son Qingge received the posthumous rank of Grand Guardian and the name Tong;

sentences.zh: 第三子意哥贈司空，賜名信；

translations.literal: the third son Yige was posthumously made Minister of Works and given the name Xin;
translations.idiomatic: the third son Yige received the posthumous rank of Minister of Works and the name Xin;

sentences.zh: 故長婦劉氏追封彭城郡夫人。

translations.literal: the late eldest daughter-in-law, née Liu, was posthumously created Lady of Pengcheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: the late eldest daughter-in-law, Lady Liu, was posthumously created Lady of Pengcheng commandery.

sentences.zh: 皇侄三人：守筠贈左領軍將軍，改名願；

translations.literal: Three imperial nephews: Shoujun was posthumously made General of the Left Military Guard and renamed Yuan;
translations.idiomatic: Three imperial nephews: Shoujun received the posthumous rank of General of the Left Military Guard and was renamed Yuan;

sentences.zh: 奉超贈左監門將軍；

translations.literal: Fengchao was posthumously made General of the Left Gate Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Fengchao received the posthumous rank of General of the Left Gate Guard;

sentences.zh: 定哥贈左千牛衛將軍，賜名遜。

translations.literal: Dingge was posthumously made General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and given the name Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Dingge received the posthumous rank of General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard and the name Xun.

sentences.zh: 故皇孫三人：宜哥贈左驍衛大將軍，賜名誼；

translations.literal: Three late imperial grandsons: Yige was posthumously made General of the Left Swift Horse Guard and given the name Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Three late imperial grandsons: Yige received the posthumous rank of General of the Left Swift Horse Guard and the name Yi;

sentences.zh: 喜哥贈武衛大將軍，賜名誠；

translations.literal: Xige was posthumously made General of the Martial Guard and given the name Cheng;
translations.idiomatic: Xige received the posthumous rank of General of the Martial Guard and the name Cheng;

sentences.zh: 三哥贈左領衛大將軍，賜名諴。

translations.literal: Sange was posthumously made General of the Left Military Guard and given the name Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Sange received the posthumous rank of General of the Left Military Guard and the name Yan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，西州回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Uyghurs of Xizhou sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Uyghurs of Xizhou sent tribute envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 前開封尹、魯國公侯益進封楚國公，前西京留守、莒國公李從敏進封秦國公，前西京留守王守恩進封莒國公。

translations.literal: The former Prefect of Kaifeng and Duke of Lu, Hou Yi, was advanced to Duke of Chu; the former Western Capital Military Governor and Duke of Ju, Li Congmin, was advanced to Duke of Qin; the former Western Capital Military Governor Wang Shou'en was advanced to Duke of Ju.
translations.idiomatic: Former Kaifeng Prefect Hou Yi, Duke of Lu, was promoted to Duke of Chu; former Western Capital Military Governor Li Congmin, Duke of Ju, to Duke of Qin; and former Western Capital Military Governor Wang Shou'en to Duke of Ju.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事李濤為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the former Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Councilor Li Tao was made Advisor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, former Vice Director of the Secretariat Li Tao, who had also served as Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor, was appointed Advisor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 詔宣徽南院使袁鳷權知開封府事，以太子太保和凝為太子太傅。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the South Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, acting Prefect of Kaifeng, and made He Ning, Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the South Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, acting Prefect of Kaifeng, and appointed He Ning, Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晉州王晏奏，河東劉崇遣偽招討使劉鈞、副招討使白截海，率步騎萬餘人來攻州城，以今月五日五道齊攻，率州兵拒之，賊軍傷死甚眾。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wang Yan of Jin prefecture memorialized that Liu Chong of Hedong had sent the false Pacification Commissioner Liu Jun and Vice Pacification Commissioner Bai Jiehai at the head of more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry to attack the prefectural city; on the fifth of this month they attacked together along five routes, and he led the prefectural troops to resist them, inflicting very heavy casualties on the rebel army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wang Yan of Jin reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had sent the rebel Pacification Commissioner Liu Jun and Vice Commissioner Bai Jiehai with more than ten thousand foot and horse to assault the city; on the fifth of the month they attacked along five routes, and Yan led the garrison in defense, killing and wounding a great many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·王晏傳》：劉崇侵晉州，晏閉關不出，設伏城上。

translations.literal: (From the "Biography of Wang Yan" in the History of Song: when Liu Chong invaded Jin prefecture, Yan closed the gates and did not come out, setting ambushes atop the walls.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the History of Song biography of Wang Yan, when Liu Chong invaded Jin, Yan shut the gates and held his men in reserve on the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 並人以為怯，競攀堞而登，晏麾伏兵擊之，顛死者甚眾，遂焚橋遁。

translations.literal: The Bing troops thought him cowardly and vied to climb the battlements; Yan waved his hidden troops to strike them, and very many fell headlong to their deaths; they then burned the bridge and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Bing soldiers took him for a coward and scrambled up the parapets; Yan signaled his ambush, and a great many fell to their deaths; the enemy then burned the bridge and fled.

sentences.zh: 晏遣子漢倫追北數十里，斬首百餘級。）〉

translations.literal: Yan sent his son Hanlun in pursuit north for several tens of li and took more than a hundred heads.) (End of editorial note.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yan sent his son Hanlun in pursuit for several tens of li and took more than a hundred heads.) (End of editorial note.)〉

sentences.zh: 內出寶玉器及金銀結縷、寶裝床幾、飲食之具數十，碎之於殿庭。

translations.literal: From within the palace were brought out several tens of precious jades, gold and silver filigree work, jewel-inlaid beds and tables, and dining utensils, and they were smashed in the palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen pieces of precious jade, gold and silver filigree, jewel-mounted beds and tables, and dining ware were brought out from the inner palace and smashed in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 帝謂侍臣曰：「凡為帝王，安用此！

translations.literal: The emperor said to his attending officials: "What need has one who would be emperor for such things!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his attendants, "What use has a ruler for such things!

sentences.zh: 」仍詔所司，凡珍華悅目之物，不得入宮。

translations.literal: " He further ordered the responsible offices that whatever rare and splendid objects pleasing to the eye must not be brought into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " He also ordered that no rare or ornamental objects meant merely to please the eye were to enter the palace.

sentences.zh: 先是，回鶻間歲入貢，禁民不得與蕃人市易寶貨，至是一聽私便交易，官不禁詰。

translations.literal: Previously, when the Uyghurs presented tribute every other year, the people were forbidden to trade precious goods with foreigners; now private trade was entirely permitted at convenience, and the authorities did not prohibit or investigate it.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when the Uyghurs sent tribute in alternate years, commoners were barred from trading valuables with foreigners; now private trade was freely allowed and officials no longer prohibited or investigated it.

sentences.zh: 丁未，左千牛將軍朱憲使契丹回。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Zhu Xian, General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard, returned from his mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Zhu Xian, General of the Left Thousand-Bull Guard, returned from his embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 契丹主烏裕遣使郭濟獻良馬一駟，賀登極。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent the envoy Guo Ji presenting a team of fine horses in congratulations on the assumption of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent the envoy Guo Ji with a team of fine horses to congratulate the emperor on his accession.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「朕祗膺景命，奄有中區，每思順物之情，從眾之欲。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict said: "We reverently received the luminous mandate and suddenly hold the central realm; we constantly think to accord with the disposition of things and follow the desires of the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, an edict declared: "Having reverently received Heaven's mandate and come to rule the central realm, We constantly seek to align with the natural order and heed the people's wishes.

sentences.zh: 將使照臨之下，多寄食僦舍之徒；

translations.literal: We wish that under Our illumination there may not be so many who lodge and take meals in rented quarters;
translations.idiomatic: We would not have so many under Our rule living as lodgers in rented quarters;

sentences.zh: 歲月之間，動懷土念家之思。

translations.literal: as the months and years pass, they are constantly moved by thoughts of native soil and longing for home.
translations.idiomatic: year after year burdened with homesickness and longing for their native places.

sentences.zh: 宜循大體，用革前規。

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the great principle and reform the former regulations.
translations.idiomatic: It is right to act on broad principle and reform the old rules.

sentences.zh: 應諸道州府，有前資朝官居住，如未赴京，不得發遣。

translations.literal: In all circuits and prefectures, where former capital officials of prior service reside, if they have not gone to the capital they must not be sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In every circuit and prefecture, former capital officials residing locally who have not been summoned to court must not be compelled to leave.

sentences.zh: 其行軍副使已下，幕職州縣官等，得替求官，自有月限，年月未滿，一聽外居。

translations.literal: As for army deputy commissioners and below, staff of prefectures and counties, and the like, when relieved of office and seeking new appointment they have their own monthly limits; if the term of months and years is not complete, they are entirely permitted to reside outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: For army deputy commissioners and below, and for prefectural, county, and staff officials seeking new posts after leaving office, the prescribed waiting period applies; until it is complete, they may all live outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 如非時詔征，不在此限。

translations.literal: If there is an extraordinary edict summoning them, this limit does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Extraordinary summons by edict are excepted from this rule.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，有司議立四親廟，從之。

translations.literal: " On the day jiyou, the responsible offices debated establishing a temple to four generations of forebears, and the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou day, the responsible offices proposed establishing a temple to four generations of ancestors, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以太子少傅楊凝式為太子少師，以太常卿張昭為戶部尚書，以尚書左丞王易為禮部尚書，以兵部侍郎邊蔚為太常卿，以翰林學士、中書舍人魚崇諒為工部侍郎充職，以戶部侍郎韋勛為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎邊歸讜為戶部侍郎，以禮部侍郎司徒詡為刑部侍郎，以秘書監趙上交為禮部侍郎，以兵部尚書王仁裕為太子少保，以翰林學士、禮部尚書張沆為刑部尚書充職，以尚書右丞田敏為左丞，以吏部侍郎段希堯為工部尚書，以太子詹事馬裔孫為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Yang Ningshi, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Minister of Rites; Bian Wei, Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafting Official, was made Vice Minister of Works in his office; Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War; Bian Guichan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Zhao Shangjiao, Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu, Minister of War, was made Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice in his office; Tian Min, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works; Ma Yisun, Chamberlain for the Heir Apparent, was made Advisor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Yang Ningshi moved from Junior Tutor to Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao from Director of Imperial Sacrifices to Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi from Left Vice Director of State Affairs to Minister of Rites; Bian Wei from Vice Minister of War to Director of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafting Official, to Vice Minister of Works; Wei Xun from Vice Minister of Revenue to Vice Minister of War; Bian Guichan from Vice Minister of Justice to Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu from Vice Minister of Rites to Vice Minister of Justice; Zhao Shangjiao from Director of the Secretariat to Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu from Minister of War to Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, to Minister of Justice; Tian Min from Right to Left Vice Director of State Affairs; Duan Xiyao from Vice Minister of Personnel to Minister of Works; and Ma Yisun from Chamberlain for the Heir Apparent to Advisor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 前鄜州節度使劉重進、前滑州節度使宋延渥，並加食邑。

translations.literal: The former Military Commissioners of Fu prefecture, Liu Chongjin, and of Hua prefecture, Song Yanwo, were both granted additional fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Former Military Commissioners Liu Chongjin of Fu and Song Yanwo of Hua both received increases to their fief income.

sentences.zh: 吐渾府留後王全德加檢校太保，充憲州刺史。

translations.literal: Wang Quande, Acting Commissioner of the Tuyuhun Prefecture, was made Acting Grand Guardian and appointed Prefect of Xian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quande, Acting Commissioner of the Tuyuhun Prefecture, was appointed Acting Grand Guardian and Prefect of Xian.

sentences.zh: 隰州刺史許遷奏，河東賊軍劉筠自晉州引兵來攻州城，尋以州兵拒之，賊軍傷死者五百人，信宿遁去。

translations.literal: Xu Qian, Prefect of Xi prefecture, memorialized that the Hedong rebel army under Liu Jun had led troops from Jin prefecture to attack the prefectural city; shortly afterward he led the prefectural troops to resist them, and five hundred of the rebel army were killed or wounded; after one night and day they fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qian, Prefect of Xi, reported that Liu Jun's Hedong rebels had marched from Jin to attack the city; he led the garrison in defense, killing or wounding five hundred of the enemy, who withdrew after a day and a night.

sentences.zh: 丁已，以尚書左丞田敏充契丹國信使。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed envoy bearing the state's credentials to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, was appointed credentialed envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs sent tribute envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 己未，天德軍節度使、虢國公郭勛加同平章事，以前宗正卿劉皞為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Concurrent Grand Councilor; the former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Concurrent Grand Councilor; former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao became Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以衛尉卿邊光範為秘書監，以前吏部侍郎李詳為吏部侍郎，以前戶部侍郎顏衎為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, was made Director of the Secretariat; the former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Personnel; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Bian Guangfan moved from Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan to Director of the Secretariat; former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang returned as Vice Minister of Personnel; and former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan became Right Vice Director of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌朔，前西京留守李從敏卒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon of the day renxu, the former Western Capital Military Governor Li Congmin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of renxu day, former Western Capital Military Governor Li Congmin died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前左武衛上將軍李懷忠為太子太傅致仕，以前邢州節度使安審暉為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; the former Military Commissioner of Xing prefecture An Shenhui was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was granted retirement as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, and former Military Commissioner of Xing An Shenhui as retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「諸州府先差散從親事官等，前朝創置，蓋出權宜，茍便一時，本非舊貫。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, an edict said: "The various prefectures and districts had previously been assigned personal attendants and intimate staff officials and the like; these were created by the previous dynasty as expedients, merely for temporary convenience, and were not originally part of established practice.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, an edict declared: "The personal attendants and intimate staff officials previously assigned by prefectures and districts were a creation of the prior dynasty—expedients for the moment, not part of long-standing practice.

sentences.zh: 近者遍詢群議，兼采封章，且言前件抽差，於理不甚允當，一則礙州縣之色役，一則妨春夏之耕耘，貧乏者困於供須，豪富者幸於影庇，既為煩擾，須至改更，況當東作之時，宜罷不急之務。

translations.literal: Recently we have broadly inquired of collective opinion and also taken up memorials, which state that the aforesaid requisitioning is not very reasonable in principle: on the one hand it obstructs the corvée duties of prefectures and counties, on the other it hinders spring and summer plowing and sowing; the poor are distressed by supplies demanded of them, while the wealthy profit from sheltering others under their names; since it is vexatious, reform is necessary; moreover, as it is the season of eastern cultivation, inessential tasks should be halted.
translations.idiomatic: We have lately consulted widely and reviewed memorials stating that such requisitioning is unjust: it blocks local corvée obligations and disrupts spring and summer farming; the poor are burdened with supplies while the wealthy profit from sheltering dependents. Because the practice is oppressive, it must be changed—and now, at the height of the planting season, nonessential duties should cease.

sentences.zh: 其諸州所差散從親事官等，並宜放散。

translations.literal: The personal attendants and intimate staff officials assigned by the various prefectures should all be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: All personal attendants and intimate staff officials assigned by the prefectures are to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」詔下，公私便之。

translations.literal: " When the edict was issued, it was convenient for both public and private interests.
translations.idiomatic: " Once the edict was promulgated, officials and commoners alike found relief.

sentences.zh: 徐州行營都部署王彥超馳奏，收復徐州。

translations.literal: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou Field Headquarters, sent an urgent memorial reporting the recovery of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou field headquarters, urgently reported the recapture of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 「城內逆首楊溫及親近徒黨並處斬。

translations.literal: "The rebel leader Yang Wen within the city and his close associates were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: "The rebel leader Yang Wen in the city and his close followers were all executed.

sentences.zh: 其餘無名目人及本城軍都將校、職掌吏民等，雖被脅從，本非同惡，並釋放。

translations.literal: The rest—persons without formal status, the army commanders and officers of the city, clerks and commoners in office, and the like—although coerced, were not originally of one mind with the wicked, and were all released.
translations.idiomatic: All others—unranked men, garrison commanders and officers, clerks, and townspeople—though coerced, were not true accomplices and were released.

sentences.zh: 兼知自前楊溫招喚草賊，同力守把，朕以村墅小民，偶被扇誘，念其庸賤，特與含容，其招入城草賊，並放歸農，仍倍加安撫。

translations.literal: It is also known that previously Yang Wen had summoned bandits from the countryside to join in holding the defenses together; We regard these village and hamlet commoners as having been incidentally incited, and considering their low and mean station, We specially extend forbearance; the bandits summoned into the city are all released to return to farming, and are to receive doubled reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: It is also known that Yang Wen had earlier recruited rural bandits to help defend the city. We regard these village folk as having been misled in passing; mindful of their humble station, We extend special leniency: the rural recruits brought into the city are all sent home to farm and given extra reassurance.

sentences.zh: 湘陰公夫人並骨肉在彼，仰差人安撫守護，勿令驚恐。

translations.literal: The lady of Duke of Xiangyin and her kin who are there—officials are ordered to send persons to reassure and protect them, and not to let them be frightened.
translations.idiomatic: The Duchess of Xiangyin and her family who remain there are to be reassured and protected by dispatched officials, without alarm.

sentences.zh: 」以右散騎常侍張煦、給事中王延藹並為左散騎常侍，以前大名府少尹李瓊為將作監，以前彰武軍節度使周密為太子太師致仕，以衛尉卿劉皞充漢隱帝山陵部署。

translations.literal: " Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official in the Secretariat, were both made Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; the former Junior Prefect of Daming Fu Li Qiong was made Director of Palace Construction; the former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, was appointed to the arrangements for the mausoleum of Emperor Yin of Han.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; former Junior Prefect of Daming Li Qiong became Director of Palace Construction; former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi received retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, was placed in charge of arrangements for Hidden Emperor of Han's mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以太子少保致仕王延為太子少傅，以戶部尚書致仕盧損、左驍衛上將軍致仕李肅並為太子少保，兵部尚書致仕韓昭允為尚書右僕射，太子太師致仕盧文紀為司空。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wang Yan, retired Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, were both made Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Lu Wenji, retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wang Yan moved from retired Junior Guardian to Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, both became Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, became Right Vice Director of State Affairs; and Lu Wenji, retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 自延而下，並依前致仕。

translations.literal: From Yan downward, all continued in retirement as before.
translations.idiomatic: From Yan downward, all remained in retirement as before.

sentences.zh: 故散騎常侍裴羽贈戶部尚書，故太子賓客蕭願贈禮部尚書，以司農卿致仕薛仁謙為鴻臚卿，以將作監致仕烏昭為太府卿，以太常少卿致仕王禧為少府監，以秘書少監致仕段颙為將作監。

translations.literal: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; the late Advisor to the Crown Prince Xiao Yuan was posthumously made Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, was made Chamberlain for Dependencies; Wu Zhao, retired Director of Palace Construction, was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Household; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Palace Workshop; Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Director of Palace Construction.
translations.idiomatic: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously created Minister of Revenue; the late Crown Prince's Advisor Xiao Yuan, Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Imperial Granaries, became Chamberlain for Dependencies; Wu Zhao, retired Director of Palace Construction, Chamberlain for the Imperial Household; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices, Director of the Palace Workshop; and Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Secretariat, Director of Palace Construction.

sentences.zh: 自仁謙而下，並依前致仕。

translations.literal: From Renqian downward, all continued in retirement as before.
translations.idiomatic: From Renqian downward, all remained in retirement as before.

sentences.zh: 詔沿淮州縣軍鎮，今後自守疆土，不得縱一人一騎擅入淮南地分。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the prefectures, counties, and garrisons along the Huai to guard their own territories hereafter and not to allow a single man or horse to enter the Huainan region on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded prefectures, counties, and garrisons along the Huai hereafter to hold their own borders and not allow any man or horse to cross into Huainan without authorization.

sentences.zh: 己卯，潞州奏，涉縣所擒河東將士二百餘人，部送赴闕。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Luzhou memorialized that more than two hundred Hedong officers and soldiers captured in She county were being escorted to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Luzhou reported that more than two hundred Hedong officers and soldiers captured in She county were being escorted to court.

sentences.zh: 詔給衫袴巾屨，放歸本土。

translations.literal: An edict provided them with jackets, trousers, headcloths, and shoes, and released them to their native regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict supplied them with clothing and footwear and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州武行德移鎮許州，何福進移鎮鎮州。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Wu Xingde of Zhen prefecture was transferred to Xu prefecture, and He Fujin was transferred to Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Wu Xingde transferred from Zhen to Xu, and He Fujin from his post to Zhen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以襄州節度副使郭令圖為宗正卿。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Guo Lingtu, Deputy Military Commissioner of Xiang prefecture, was made Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Guo Lingtu, Deputy Military Commissioner of Xiang, was appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「故蘇逢吉、劉銖，頃在漢朝，與朕同事。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The late Su Fengji and Liu Zhu, who not long ago in the Han dynasty served together with Us,
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "The late Su Fengji and Liu Zhu once served with Us in the Han court.

sentences.zh: 朕自平禍亂，不念仇讎，尋示優宏，與全家屬。

translations.literal: since We pacified the turmoil have not borne old enmities in mind, and soon showed generous magnanimity toward their entire families.
translations.idiomatic: Since We pacified the turmoil, We have not held old grudges and soon showed their whole families generous mercy.

sentences.zh: 尚以幼稚無托，衣食是艱，將行矜恤之恩，俾獲生存之路，報怨以德，非我負人。

translations.literal: Yet because their young children are without support and food and clothing are hard to obtain, We shall extend compassionate care so that they may gain a path to survival; to repay enmity with virtue—We have not wronged others.
translations.idiomatic: Yet their young children are unsupported and lack food and clothing; We will extend compassionate care so they may survive—repaying enmity with kindness, for We have not wronged others.

sentences.zh: 賜逢吉骨肉洛京莊宅各一，賜劉銖骨肉陜州莊宅各一。

translations.literal: We grant to Fengji's kin one estate in the Luoyang capital each, and to Liu Zhu's kin one estate in Shan prefecture each.
translations.idiomatic: We grant Fengji's kin an estate each in the Luoyang capital, and Liu Zhu's kin an estate each in Shan.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，幸南莊。

translations.literal: " On the day jichou, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: " On jichou day, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，唐故郇國公李從益追封許王，唐明宗淑妃王氏追贈賢妃。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Li Congyi, the late Duke of Xun of Tang, was posthumously created Prince of Xu; the late Virtuous Consort Wang of Tang Emperor Mingzong was posthumously honored as Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Li Congyi, late Duke of Xun of Tang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xu; and Virtuous Consort Wang of Tang Emperor Mingzong was posthumously created Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔：「諸道節度副使、行軍司馬、兩京少尹、留守判官，並許差定當直，人力不得過十五人；

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict said: "Deputy military commissioners of the circuits, army marshals, junior prefects of the two capitals, and military governors' judicial assessors are all permitted to assign fixed duty attendants, and manpower must not exceed fifteen persons;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, an edict declared: "Deputy military commissioners, army marshals, junior prefects of the two capitals, and military governors' judicial assessors may assign fixed duty attendants, but not more than fifteen persons;

sentences.zh: 諸府少尹、書記、支使、防禦團練副使，不得過十人；

translations.literal: junior prefects of prefectures, secretaries, branch commissioners, and deputy commissioners of defense and training regiments must not exceed ten persons;
translations.idiomatic: junior prefects, secretaries, branch commissioners, and deputy defense and training commissioners may not exceed ten;

sentences.zh: 節度推官、防卸團練軍事判官，不得過七人，逐處系帳收管。

translations.literal: judicial reviewers of military commissioners and military judicial assessors of defense and training regiments must not exceed seven persons; in each place they are to be registered and kept on the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: judicial reviewers of military commissioners and military assessors of defense and training regiments may not exceed seven, and each post must keep them on the official rolls.

sentences.zh: 此外如敢額外影占人戶，其本官當行朝典。

translations.literal: Beyond this, if anyone dares to take additional households under covert registration, the responsible official shall be subject to court punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who covertly registers extra households beyond these limits shall face court discipline against the responsible official.

sentences.zh: 」先是，漢隱帝時，有人上言：「州府從事令錄，皆請料錢，自合雇人驅使，不合差遣百姓丁戶。

translations.literal: " Previously, in the time of Hidden Emperor of Han, someone submitted a memorial saying: "Prefectural and district staff officials and recorders all receive stipends and should hire persons to serve them themselves; they ought not requisition commoners' corvée households.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, under Hidden Emperor of Han, a memorial had argued that prefectural staff and recorders, who received stipends, should hire their own servants and not requisition commoners for corvée.

sentences.zh: 」秉政者然之，乃下詔州府從事令錄，本處先差職役，並放歸農。

translations.literal: " Those holding power approved this, and an edict was issued that the staff officials and recorders of prefectures and districts who had previously been assigned corvée duties locally were all released to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: " The authorities agreed and ordered that corvée laborers previously assigned to prefectural staff and recorders be released to farming.

sentences.zh: 自是官吏有獨行趨府縣者，帝頗知之，故有是命。

translations.literal: From this time officials were seen going alone to prefectures and districts, which the emperor knew quite well, and therefore there was this order.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward officials were seen traveling alone to prefectures and counties, which the emperor well knew—hence this order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰朔，詔沿淮州縣，許淮南人就淮北糴易糇糧，時淮南饑故也。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the new moon of the day renchen, an edict ordered the prefectures and counties along the Huai to permit people of Huainan to come to Huaibei to purchase and exchange dry provisions, because Huainan was then suffering famine.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the new moon of renchen day, an edict allowed Huainan people to buy dry grain north of the Huai, as Huainan was then in famine.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以夫人董氏為德妃，仍令所司備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Lady Dong was made Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were ordered to prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Lady Dong was created Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were ordered to prepare investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改侍衛馬步軍軍額。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the designations of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies were changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the designations of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies were changed.

sentences.zh: 馬軍舊稱護聖，今改為龍捷；

translations.literal: the horse army, formerly called Guard of the Sage, was now changed to Dragon Swift;
translations.idiomatic: The horse army, formerly Guard of the Sage, was renamed Dragon Swift;

sentences.zh: 步軍舊稱奉國，今改為虎捷。

translations.literal: the foot army, formerly called Serving the State, was now changed to Tiger Swift.
translations.idiomatic: the foot army, formerly Serving the State, was renamed Tiger Swift.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔唐莊宗、明宗、晉高祖三處陵寢，各有守陵宮人，並放逐便。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict ordered that at the three mausoleum sites of Tang Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Jin Gaozu, each of which had palace women guarding the tombs, they were all to be dismissed and sent away as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, an edict ordered the palace women guarding the mausoleums of Tang Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Jin Gaozu all dismissed and sent away.

sentences.zh: 如願在陵所者，依舊供給。

translations.literal: Those who wished to remain at the mausoleum sites were to be supplied as before.
translations.idiomatic: Those who wished to remain at the tombs were to be supplied as before.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，相州張彥成移鎮鄧州，折從阮移鎮滑州，李筠移鎮相州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Zhang Yancheng of Xiang prefecture was transferred to Deng prefecture, Zhe Congruan was transferred to Hua prefecture, and Li Jun was transferred to Xiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zhang Yancheng transferred from Xiang to Deng, Zhe Congruan to Hua, and Li Jun to Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，亳州防卸使王重裔卒。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wang Chongyi, Commissioner of Defense of Bozhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wang Chongyi, Defense Commissioner of Bozhou, died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，皇第四女封壽安公主。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the fourth imperial daughter was created Princess of Shou'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the fourth imperial daughter was enfeoffed as Princess of Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，故許州節度使劉信追封蔡王。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Liu Xin, the late Military Commissioner of Xu prefecture, was posthumously created Prince of Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Liu Xin, late Military Commissioner of Xu, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Cai.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「牧守之任，委遇非輕，分憂之務既同，制祿之數宜等。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict said: "The charge of prefects and governors is no light commission; since the duty of sharing cares is the same, the regulated salary amounts ought to be equal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, an edict declared: "The office of prefect and governor is no light trust; since their burden of shared governance is the same, their regulated salaries ought to be equal.

sentences.zh: 自前有富庶之郡，請給則優，或邊侄之州，俸料素薄。

translations.literal: From of old wealthy and populous commanderies received generous allowances when requested, while some border prefectures had always had thin salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly wealthy prefectures received generous allowances on request, while some border prefectures had always had meager salaries.

sentences.zh: 以至遷除之際，擬議亦難，既論資敘之高低，又患祿秩之升降。

translations.literal: Thus at the time of transfers and promotions deliberation was also difficult, for one must consider both the high and low of seniority and rank, and also worry over the rise and fall of salary grades.
translations.idiomatic: At transfers and promotions deliberation was difficult, weighing both seniority and the rise and fall of salary grades.

sentences.zh: 所宜分多益寡，均利同恩，冀無黨無偏，以勸勛效。

translations.literal: It is fitting to take from the many to benefit the few, equalize profit and share grace alike, hoping for neither faction nor partiality, so as to encourage meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: The court should take from the abundant to aid the meager, equalize benefits and share favor alike, and seek impartiality so as to encourage loyal service.

sentences.zh: 今定諸防禦使料錢二百貫，祿粟一百石，食鹽五石，馬十匹草粟，元隨三十人衣糧；

translations.literal: Now it is fixed that defense commissioners receive two hundred strings of stipend cash, one hundred piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt for consumption, fodder for ten horses, and provisions for thirty original followers;
translations.idiomatic: Defense commissioners were now fixed at two hundred strings of stipend cash, one hundred piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, fodder for ten horses, and provisions for thirty personal attendants;

sentences.zh: 團練使一百五十貫，祿粟七十石，鹽五石，馬十匹，元隨三十人；

translations.literal: training regiment commissioners one hundred fifty strings, seventy piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, ten horses, and thirty original followers;
translations.idiomatic: training regiment commissioners at one hundred fifty strings, seventy piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, ten horses, and thirty attendants;

sentences.zh: 刺史一百貫，祿粟五十石，鹽五石，馬五匹，元隨二十人」云。

translations.literal: prefects one hundred strings, fifty piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, five horses, and twenty original followers," it was said.
translations.idiomatic: and prefects at one hundred strings, fifty piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, five horses, and twenty attendants," the edict concluded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，尚書左丞田敏使契丹回。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, returned from his mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, returned from his embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 契丹主兀欲遣。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent

sentences.zh: 使耨姑報命，並獻碧玉金塗銀裹鞍勒各一副，弓矢、器仗、貂裘等，土產馬三十匹、土產漢馬十匹。

translations.literal: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, and also presented one set each of jade-and-gold-inlaid silver-mounted saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, weapons and armor, sable furs, and the like, thirty native horses and ten native Han horses.
translations.idiomatic: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, together with jade saddles with gold inlay and silver mountings, bows and arrows, arms and armor, sable furs, thirty native horses, and ten native Han horses.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝為故貴妃張氏舉哀於舊宮，輟視朝三日。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the emperor conducted mourning for the late Noble Consort Zhang at the former palace and suspended court audiences for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the emperor mourned the late Noble Consort Zhang at the former palace and suspended court for three days.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，司空致仕盧文紀卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Lu Wenji, retired Minister of Works, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Lu Wenji, retired Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon of the day xinmao, the court was not held, because the coffin of Hidden Emperor of Han was still in temporary interment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of xinmao day, court was not held because Hidden Emperor of Han's coffin remained in temporary interment.

sentences.zh: 甲午，百僚上表，請以七月二十八日皇帝降聖日為永壽節，從之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the hundred officials submitted a memorial requesting that the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month, the emperor's birth day, be made the Everlong Festival, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the officials memorialized that the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month, the emperor's birthday, be established as the Everlong Festival, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 邢州大雨霖。

translations.literal: Xing prefecture suffered prolonged heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Xing prefecture suffered prolonged heavy rains.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太常少卿劉悅上漢少帝謚曰隱皇帝，陵曰穎陵，從之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Liu Yue, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted that the posthumous title of the Han Lesser Emperor be Hidden Emperor and his mausoleum Yingling, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Liu Yue, Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices, proposed the posthumous title Hidden Emperor and mausoleum Yingling for the Han Lesser Emperor, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以樞密使王峻為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎、同平章事、監修國史，充樞密使；

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Supervisor of the Compilation of National History, continuing as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Left Vice Director of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Supervisor of the National History, while retaining the bureau commission;

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使、尚書兵部侍郎範質為中書侍郎、同平章事，充集賢殿大學士；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of War in the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of War, became Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎、判三司李穀為中書侍郎、同平章事，判三司。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of the Three Offices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Commissioner of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of the Three Offices, became Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and continued as Commissioner of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 司徒兼侍中、監修國史竇貞固，司空兼中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢殿大學士蘇禹珪，並罷相守本官。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Education and concurrent Palace Attendant and Supervisor of the Compilation of National History, and Su Yugui, Minister of Works and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies, were both removed as chancellors and retained their original offices.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Education, Palace Attendant, and Supervisor of National History, and Su Yugui, Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies, were both removed as chancellors while retaining their original posts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the emperor visited the Western Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the emperor visited the Western Estate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔宰臣範質參知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, an edict ordered Grand Councilor Fan Zhi to participate in the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, an edict ordered Grand Councilor Fan Zhi to participate in Bureau of Military Affairs affairs.

sentences.zh: 鄴都、洺、滄、貝等州大雨霖。

translations.literal: Yedu, Luo, Cang, Bei, and other prefectures suffered prolonged heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Yedu, Luo, Cang, Bei, and other prefectures suffered prolonged heavy rains.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，西京奏，新授宗正卿郭令圖卒。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Western Capital memorialized that Guo Lingtu, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Western Capital reported that Guo Lingtu, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court, had died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以尚書左丞顏衎為兵部侍郎，充端明殿學士；

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Yan Kan, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of War and Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Yan Kan, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Minister of War and Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使翟光鄴兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: Zhai Guangye, Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guangye, Commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was also appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，帝被袞冕，禦崇元殿，授太廟四室寶冊於中書令馮道等，赴西京行禮。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the new moon of the day xinyou, the emperor donned ceremonial robes and caps, took the throne in the Hall of Lofty Origins, and entrusted the precious registers of the four chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple to Director of the Secretariat Feng Dao and others to proceed to the Western Capital to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the new moon of xinyou day, the emperor wore full ceremonial dress, took the throne in the Hall of Lofty Origins, and entrusted the ancestral temple registers of all four chambers to Director of the Secretariat Feng Dao and others to carry the rites at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書左丞田敏兼判國子監事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made concurrent Administrator of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, was also appointed Administrator of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以卸史中丞於德辰為尚書右丞，以秘書監邊光範為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Yu Dechen, Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Bian Guangfan, Director of the Secretariat, was made Advisor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yu Dechen, Censor-in-Chief, became Right Vice Director of State Affairs; and Bian Guangfan, Director of the Secretariat, became Advisor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書張昭為太子賓客，以其子秉為陽翟簿，犯法抵罪，昭詣閣待罪，詔釋之，乃左授此官。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao, Minister of Revenue, was made Advisor to the Crown Prince; because his son Bing, Registrar of Yangdi, had violated the law and been punished, Zhao went to the palace gate to await judgment, was pardoned by edict, and therefore received this demoted appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao, Minister of Revenue, was appointed Advisor to the Crown Prince after his son Bing, Registrar of Yangdi, broke the law and was punished; Zhao presented himself at the palace gate to await judgment, was pardoned by edict, and received this demoted post.

sentences.zh: 壬申，史官賈緯等以所撰《晉高祖實錄》三十卷、《少帝實錄》二十卷上之。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the historiographers Jia Wei and others presented the thirty juan of the Veritable Records of Jin Gaozu and the twenty juan of the Veritable Records of the Lesser Emperor that they had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, historiographers Jia Wei and others presented the thirty-juan Veritable Records of Jin Gaozu and the twenty-juan Veritable Records of the Lesser Emperor they had compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸宰臣王峻第。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the emperor visited the residence of Grand Councilor Wang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the emperor visited Grand Councilor Wang Jun's residence.

sentences.zh: 己丑，鎮州奏，破河東賊軍於平山縣西，斬首五百級。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Zhen prefecture memorialized that the Hedong rebel army had been defeated west of Pingshan county, with five hundred heads taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Zhen reported defeating the Hedong rebels west of Pingshan county and taking five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 是日，太常卿邊蔚奏，議改郊廟舞名，事具《樂志》。

translations.literal: That same day, Bian Wei, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized proposing to change the names of suburban and temple dances; the matter is fully recorded in the Treatise on Music.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Bian Wei, Director of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized proposing new names for suburban and temple dances, as detailed in the Treatise on Music.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，漢隱帝梓宮發引，帝詣太平宮臨奠，詔群臣出祖於西郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, the coffin of Hidden Emperor of Han was sent forth; the emperor went to the Palace of Great Peace to offer libations and ordered the ministers to perform the farewell rites at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Hidden Emperor of Han's coffin was sent forth; the emperor went to the Palace of Great Peace to mourn and ordered the ministers to perform farewell rites at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 是歲，幽州饑，流人散入滄州界。

translations.literal: That year, You prefecture suffered famine, and refugees scattered into the borders of Cang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year You prefecture suffered famine, and refugees scattered into Cang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔流人至者，口給鬥粟，仍給無主土田，令取便種蒔，放免差稅。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that refugees who arrived be given a dou of grain per person, and also granted ownerless land for them to plant as convenient, with corvée and tax obligations waived.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that arriving refugees receive a dou of grain per person, be granted ownerless land to plant as they chose, and be exempted from corvée and taxes.

sentences.zh: 癸已，虎入西京修行寺傷人，市民殺之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, a tiger entered the Xingxing Temple in the Western Capital and injured people; townspeople killed it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, a tiger entered Xingxing Temple in the Western Capital and injured people; townspeople killed it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸班荊館。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the emperor visited the Lodge for Parting Guests.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the emperor visited the Lodge for Parting Guests.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，契丹遣幽州牙將曹繼筠來歸故晉中書令趙瑩之喪，詔贈太傅，仍賜其子絹五百匹，以備喪事，歸葬於華陰故裏。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Khitan sent Cao Jijun, a military adjutant of You prefecture, to return the remains of the late Jin Director of the Secretariat Zhao Ying; an edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor and also granted his son five hundred bolts of silk for funeral expenses, with burial in his old home in Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Khitan sent You military adjutant Cao Jijun to return the remains of late Jin Director of the Secretariat Zhao Ying; the court posthumously created him Grand Preceptor, granted his son five hundred bolts of silk for the funeral, and ordered burial in his native Huayin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the emperor visited the Western Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the emperor visited the Western Estate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，晉州王晏移鎮徐州，滄州王景移鎮河中，定州孫方簡移鎮華州，永興郭從義移鎮許州，貝州王繼宏移鎮河陽，李暉移鎮滄州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Wang Yan of Jin prefecture was transferred to Xu prefecture, Wang Jing of Cang to Hezhong, Sun Fangjian of Ding to Hua, Guo Congyi of Yongxing to Xu, Wang Jihong of Bei to Heyang, and Li Hui to Cang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Wang Yan transferred from Jin to Xu, Wang Jing from Cang to Hezhong, Sun Fangjian from Ding to Hua, Guo Congyi from Yongxing to Xu, Wang Jihong from Bei to Heyang, and Li Hui to Cang.

sentences.zh: 以許州節度使武行德為西京留守，滑州折從阮移鎮陜州，河中扈彥珂移鎮滑州，陜州李洪信移鎮永興，華州王饒移鎮貝州，徐州王彥超移鎮晉州。

translations.literal: Wu Xingde, Military Commissioner of Xu prefecture, was made Military Governor of the Western Capital; Zhe Congruan of Hua was transferred to Shan prefecture; Hu Yanke of Hezhong to Hua; Li Hongxin of Shan to Yongxing; Wang Rao of Hua to Bei; and Wang Yanchao of Xu to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xingde, Military Commissioner of Xu, became Military Governor of the Western Capital; Zhe Congruan transferred from Hua to Shan; Hu Yanke from Hezhong to Hua; Li Hongxin from Shan to Yongxing; Wang Rao from Hua to Bei; and Wang Yanchao from Xu to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，尚食李氏等宮官八人並封縣君，司記劉氏等六人並封郡夫人，尚宮皇甫氏等三人並封國夫人。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, eight palace officials including Li of the Bureau of Imperial Food were all created Ladies of a county; six including Liu of the Bureau of Records were all created Ladies of a commandery; and three including Huangfu of the Palace Attendants Bureau were all created Ladies of a state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, eight palace officials including Li of Imperial Food were created county ladies; six including Liu of Records, commandery ladies; and three including Huangfu of Palace Attendants, state ladies.

sentences.zh: 唐制有內官、宮官，各有司存，更不加郡國之號，近代加之，非舊典也。

translations.literal: The Tang system had inner officials and palace officials, each with its own office, and did not further add titles of commandery or state; recent times have added them—this is not the old standard.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang institutions, inner and palace officials each had their own bureaus and were not given commandery or state titles; recent times have added such titles, which is not the old standard.

sentences.zh: 以易州刺史孫行友為定州留後。

translations.literal: Sun Xingyou, Prefect of Yi prefecture, was made Acting Commissioner of Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Xingyou, Prefect of Yi, was appointed Acting Commissioner of Ding.

sentences.zh: 戊午，故夫人柴氏追立為皇后，仍令所司定謚，備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the late Lady Chai was posthumously established as empress, and the responsible offices were ordered to fix her posthumous title and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the late Lady Chai was posthumously enthroned as empress, and the responsible offices were ordered to fix her posthumous title and prepare investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，帝詣太平宮起居漢太后。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the new moon of the day gengshen, the emperor went to the Palace of Great Peace to inquire after the health of the Han Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of gengshen day, the emperor went to the Palace of Great Peace to inquire after Han Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，故夫人楊氏追贈淑妃，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the late Lady Yang was posthumously honored as Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the late Lady Yang was posthumously created Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 故皇第五女追封永寧公主。

translations.literal: The late fifth imperial daughter was posthumously created Princess of Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: The late fifth imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定州奏，契丹永康王烏裕為部下所殺。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Ding prefecture memorialized that Wuyu, Prince of Yongkang of the Khitan, had been killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ding reported that Wuyu, Prince of Yongkang of the Khitan, had been killed by his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前耀州團練使武廷翰為太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Wu Tinghan, former Commissioner of the Training Regiment of Yao prefecture, was made retired Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Wu Tinghan, former Training Regiment Commissioner of Yao, received retirement as Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諸道兵馬都元帥、兩浙節度使、檢校太師、尚書令、中書令、吳越國王錢俶加天下兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Qian Chu, Commander-in-Chief of All Circuits' Armies and Horses, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe, Acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Department of State Affairs, Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, was made Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Qian Chu, Commander-in-Chief of All Circuits' Armies, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe, Acting Grand Preceptor, Director of State Affairs, Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, was promoted to Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，中書舍人劉濤責授少府少監，分司西京，坐遣男頊代草制詞也。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Liu Tao, Drafting Official in the Secretariat, was demoted to Vice Director of the Palace Workshop and assigned to the Western Capital branch office, because he had had his son Xu draft edicts in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Liu Tao, Secretariat Drafting Official, was demoted to Vice Director of the Palace Workshop and assigned to the Western Capital branch for having his son Xu draft edicts on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 監察御史劉頊責授復州司戶，坐代父草制也。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Liu Xu was demoted to Registrar of Fu prefecture, because he had drafted edicts for his father.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Liu Xu was demoted to Registrar of Fu for drafting edicts on his father's behalf.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人楊昭儉解官放逐私便，以多在假告，不親其職也。

translations.literal: Yang Zhaojian, Drafting Official in the Secretariat, was removed from office and banished at private convenience, because he was often on leave and did not attend to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhaojian, Secretariat Drafting Official, was dismissed and banished for frequently taking leave and neglecting his duties.
